visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: Call-to-action box placed beside intro text in a 60/30 split: light grey box with linked title, optional "Find out more" description and an orange arrow; the ochre option is an orange box with white text and a white external-link icon.
visualCharacteristics.variantRationale: Single call-to-action box with linked title and arrow, no image; colour is an option (grey default, ochre)
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Call-to-action link box with heading text and arrow

contentPattern.summary: Styled call-to-action card placed beside the default content; the whole box is a link
contentPattern.structure: one row per box: [title (linked), optional description]

blockContent.description: Grey box "Researcher development programs" / "Find out more"; ochre box "View the full event program" linking to a PDF

usage: A single (or a few) call-to-action boxes with a linked title and optional short description; the whole box is clickable and shows an arrow, or an external-link icon when the link leaves the site or points to a file.
reuseGuidance: Use beside default content in a split section to promote one destination. Add the ochre option (Cards CTA (ochre)) for the orange box. Use cards-icon-tile when the call to action has an icon and no box.
